label: D2 after choosing a2 following an unrewarded trial, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the GO choice just made was a2 (in_action == 2) and the previous trial went unrewarded (prev_reward == 0 holds 97.6% of the activation mass). It is almost silent before episode trial ~50 and peaks at trials 60-89. Within that, it almost never fires when a2 was a switch away from a1 (prev_action == 1 gives 16 activations). It prefers the S2 state (78% of mass) and low-to-mid value / a2-leaning policy logits. Base predicate (D2 & a2 & prev unrewarded) gets mass recall 0.98 but precision 0.30; adding ep_trial >= 55 and not-a-switch-from-a1 raises dev F1 to 0.76 at mass recall 0.97. All variables are observed at D2. Never fires at D1 or GO, after an a1 choice, or after a rewarded previous trial (2% of mass). Remaining false positives are weak or zero activations in the same context, so the activation size within this context is not captured; I did not check what drives it.
